choice.basis: The dashboard 'Public Service Feedback Share by Category' shows Service Delivery at 18%, which is the lowest feedback share among all categories (Service Quality 50%, Service Cost 42%, Service Design 47%, Support Access 51%, Other 38%). The routing criterion specifies selecting the lowest feedback share for the low-feedback coverage follow-up workflow.
choice.option_label: Route Service Delivery to low-feedback coverage follow-up
